notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build year, design, height, builder or removal date appears in any source read. The Lake County table is a rough, interleaved layout, so its 'Removed.' wording is a secondary record. Do not confuse this with Stony Ridge (state tower 30, Itasca County, 47.65245, -93.18944 in the FFLA list): the 2025 compilation says that tower was restored and moved to Anoka County. The web search snippet about who renamed the tower and when is unverified and not used.
